spans.s:
मपष्ट मपष्ट or मपष्टक or मपु-
ष्टक, अस्, m. (= मकुष्टक, मयुष्टक), a
kind of bean, (written also मपुष्ठक.)

मापक मापक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. Caus. of rt.
3. मा), serving for measuring or weighing, a
measurer, &c.

मापन, अस्, m. a pair of scales, balance; (आ), f.
measuring; measuring or meting out, making a place
for a sacrifice, measure; (अम्), n. the act of measur-
ing; forming, making, formation.

मापत्य मापत्य, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. 1. मा
+ अपत्य, i. e. not a child in the ordinary sense,
cf. मनसि-ज; according to others fr. Caus. of rt.
मे), a term applied to the god of love or Kāma-
deva, (according to some, मापत्य, अस्, m.)

मापयान, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. the Caus.), crossing
over (fr. rt. 3. मा ?).
